plugin.description: Turns the deck into a game controller: it creates a virtual gamepad and the actions press its buttons and move its axes.
plugin.requirements: Access to /dev/uinput so the virtual gamepad can be created. Without it the actions do nothing.

Joystick.description: Moves one axis of the virtual gamepad. Put one on a key with a value and another with value 0 on a second key, or use "Add to Value" on two keys to nudge an axis in both directions.

axis.description: Which axis to move. The two last ones can move the mouse cursor as well - avoid them unless that is wanted.

operation.description: "Set Value" puts the axis at the value, "Add to Value" moves it by that much from where it is.

value.description: How far to deflect the axis, in percent from -100 to 100. For the two D-pad axes it is -1, 0 or 1 instead.

JoystickButtons.description: Presses a button on the virtual gamepad. It can tap the button, hold it down, release it again, or toggle it.

action_type.description: "Press and Release" taps the button. "Press" holds it down until a "Release" action lets go - use those two on separate keys. "Toggle" flips between held and released.

duration.description: How long the button stays down, in seconds. Only used with "Press and Release".
